summary: The dotted world map cropped to the region around the delivery hubs lies tilted like a tabletop model, with a solid column rising at each hub and an upright label (city, role, headcount). Column height follows headcount on a log scale only when every hub has a headcount from the brief; otherwise all columns are equal. Hovering or focusing a hub card below lifts its column and draws a thin arc to the head office (the hub marked hq). Tilt, turn and column colours are seeded from the brand name. Needs 2-8 real hubs (city keys), a role each, optional headcount and detail.
